description:
﻿ Seeking a highly motivated Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support the mission-critical Joint Fires Network (JFN), a system integral to modern military operations by enabling seamless integration of joint planning, targeting, precision strikes, and communications. In this role, you will ensure JFN's reliability, scalability, and performance while driving automation initiatives and operational excellence within a dynamic environment. Leveraging key performance metrics and advanced dashboards, you will monitor system reliability, maintainability, and operational availability, identifying trends, addressing potential issues, and enabling data-driven decisions to enhance system health and efficiency. This position offers an opportunity to play a pivotal role in strengthening system management and supporting continuous improvements critical to military success. This position is on-site in Camp Smith, HI. 

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Responsible for ensuring Operational System’s maximum availability, stability and health of required program resources below to support Operations, Experimentation, Development and Testing 
 
 JFN:  MLS Operational Architecture including nodes, hub, network, software baseline and CI/CD apparatus (e.g. IL-7 Cloud) 

 JMIE: MLS Experimentation Architecture including labs, systems, network, software baseline CI/CD apparatus (e.g. IL-5 Cloud) 

 

 Maintain the availability and reliability of operational to include infrastructure to application layer from inception to incident resolution. 

 Proactively monitor system health, analyze trends, and predict system behavior to reduce downtime and latency. 

 Serve as the escalation point during incidents, lead troubleshooting efforts, and drive root cause analysis to reduce Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 

 Establish and improve existing Engineering processes and tools to provide system status by leveraging platform, data and application layer logging apparatus 

 Establish a Standard Operations Procedure (SOP) to leverage CI/CD pipelines and Automated Testing Tools to audit, verify, update, patch and manage Systems 

 Develop, maintain, and Automate repetitive processes to reduce manual support of daily operational verification and validation of critical operational functional capabilities. 

 Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to simplify provisioning, scaling, and fault recovery for JFN environments. 

 Establish a Communications Plan to ensure stakeholders, program leadership and others are well informed on System Status 

 Identify deficiencies in DevSecOps workflows and design solutions to support Technical Operations 

 Conduct performance profiling identify bottlenecks and implement optimizations for improved system performance. 

 Collaborate with helpdesk, network engineers, system integrators to promote best practices in escalation and incident response to ensure system reliability.   

 Prepare detailed reports and presentations on findings and share insights with stakeholders. 

 Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, and advancements in automated testing, distributed databases, software defined networking, container orchestration, and DevSecOps. 

 

 ﻿TYPICAL EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelors and five (5) years or more experience; Masters and three (3) years or more experience; PhD and 0 years related experience
 5+ years of progressive experience in Computer Science, Networking and Information Technology, including Systems Engineering, DevSecOps, and application lifecycle management. 
 Proven track record in designing and implementing governance processes for engineering environments. 
 Experience with building and maintain dashboards, alerting and monitoring solutions to provide complete observability into system health, both in real time and over historical trends. 
 Strong experience with Linux/Unix and Windows systems administration in both virtualized and cloud environments. 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and deployment automation tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, etc.). 
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and hybrid cloud deployment strategies. 
 Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (e.g., Alloy, Blackbox Exporter, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack). 
 Ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate with application providers. 
 Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. 
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with experience in reporting project status to leadership. 
 Familiarity with modern IT frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Agile, ITIL). 
 Understanding of business and technical alignment to achieve organizational goals. 
 U.S. Citizenship and an active TS/SCI clearance. 
 IAT Level II certification. 

 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives.
